data.why: The brief has 2 outcomes inside one capability, so the route is an epic.

high_risk.basis: Applied to the files each shipped rule's slice changed when it was merged, as this computer has them. The rule is the security scan's (sign-in or permissions, billing, a database schema or migration, an existing contract).
high_risk.not_determined_note: Not determined for SLICE-001/FR-01, SLICE-001/INV-02: nothing on this computer says which files their slice changed.

data.rule: One outcome in one capability, at most 1 shipped rule and nothing in a high-risk area is a small change; otherwise one outcome and at most three shipped rules is one slice; otherwise outcomes inside one capability is an epic, and outcomes in different capabilities is several epics. Concerns are counted, never part of the rule; high-risk areas are part of it only for a small change.
